main_text.p: Christus aut docet, aut edit miracula, otiosus nunquam legitur. doctrina & miracula sunt muneris publici,& veriMessiæ:præcipuum tamen doctrina & principale. miracula doctri-nam comitantur vt testes, qui fidem faciunt, confirmant auditores, conuincunt aduersarios.

Et quanquam Christus hæc coniuncta tracta-rit, h. e, simul cum miraculis docuerit: tamen historiæ euangelicæ non vtrunque simul descri-bunt: aliàs enim sola miracula recensent, aliàs solam doctrinam,aliàs vtrunque simul.Sic præ-cedenti capite profecutus est miracula Christi in monte,quæ sanando & cibando patrauit: sic iam ad doctrinam Christi redit. Ac vti audito-rum est diuersitas,ita doctor Christus genus di-cendi variat. Cum aduersariis est acer, cum di-scipulis patiens,cum turbis misericors,cum pri-uatis mitis,& clemens: & cùm omnia norit,ta-men suos certo fine ad certam vtilitatem explo-rat, cuius rei sequens caput specimen nobis ex-hibet.

Partes cap. xvi. sunt quatuor. 1 De signis quæ tentando petunt Pharisæi & Sadducæi, quibus nullum datur præter Ionæ Prophetæ. 11 Admonitio Christi ad discipulos de cauendo fermento. i.doctrina Pharisæorum verfu.5. 111 Explorat Christus quæ sint populi de se iudicia, quid item discipuli de seipso sentiant: quo loco habetur splendida Petri confessio, nec non elegans Christi commendatio & promissio verf. 13.[?] iv. Vaticinium suæ mortis, & admonitio de officio suorum sectatorum in tolerandâ eruce & persecutione.verfu.21.
Priora tria membra adhuc ad antecedentem

page.notes: Scan is clear overall. Doubtful readings: the verse numbers in the italic summary block ("verf. 13.[?] iv.", "verfu.5.", "verfu.21.") and the roman numerals 1, 11, 111, iv. The word "eruce" is printed as shown and may be a printing error for "cruce". The "Priora" line is set in a larger, bolder type than the body, and is treated as running text. The italic block is treated as a foot block of smaller summary lines. Lines are not split into separate notes because they run together in the printed block.
